snow_game_home_prep_cover_gap_even_seaso.classification_evidence: N=10 snow games on the even-seasons half alone; interval crosses zero. Same construct as snow_game_home_prep_cover_gap_odd_seasons, disjoint season half. Both halves lean the same (positive) direction, which is consistent with the pooled read but far from resolving it at this N.
snow_game_home_prep_cover_gap_even_seaso.description: LEAD-38 split-half check (even-numbered seasons half): home cover rate gap, snow games vs population, restricted to even-numbered REG seasons 2009-2025.
snow_game_home_prep_cover_gap_even_seaso.notes: week-blocked bootstrap within the even-seasons subset only, 20000 draws, seed 20260911; script scripts/snow_game_home_prep_screen.py screen. Paired odd-seasons entry: snow_game_home_prep_cover_gap_odd_seasons.
snow_game_home_prep_cover_gap_even_seaso.plain_summary: Splitting the snow-game seasons in half (even years only), the home-team edge again leans slightly positive, matching the odd-years half, but the sample is still tiny.

snow_game_home_prep_cover_gap_odd_season.classification_evidence: N=12 snow games on the odd-seasons half alone; interval crosses zero. snow_flag is a per-game situational condition, not a persistent per-team trait, so a formal split-half correlation coefficient does not apply the way it would to a trait; this entry and its even-seasons sibling report the same construct measured independently on disjoint season halves instead.
snow_game_home_prep_cover_gap_odd_season.description: LEAD-38 split-half check (odd-numbered seasons half): home cover rate gap, snow games vs population, restricted to odd-numbered REG seasons 2009-2025.
snow_game_home_prep_cover_gap_odd_season.notes: week-blocked bootstrap within the odd-seasons subset only, 20000 draws, seed 20260911; script scripts/snow_game_home_prep_screen.py screen. Paired even-seasons entry: snow_game_home_prep_cover_gap_even_seasons.
snow_game_home_prep_cover_gap_odd_season.plain_summary: Splitting the snow-game seasons in half (odd years only), the home-team edge still leans slightly positive, but with only 12 games this half proves little on its own.

snow_game_home_prep_cover_gap_vs_cold_ou.classification_evidence: N=22 snow games vs 167 cold-but-not-snow outdoor games; interval crosses zero on both blockings and the point estimate leans slightly negative. Not a resolved wrong sign (interval does not sit entirely below zero on either blocking) and no positive control has been run; recorded unresolved_below_power.
snow_game_home_prep_cover_gap_vs_cold_ou.description: LEAD-38: home cover rate in forecast-snow games minus home cover rate in other outdoor games that are also forecast-freezing (temp<=32F) but do not clear the precip-probability threshold (the marginal contribution of precipitation given cold). Predeclared direction: positive.
snow_game_home_prep_cover_gap_vs_cold_ou.notes: week-blocked primary (block=season*100+week), season-blocked secondary; 20000-draw block bootstrap, seed 20260911; script scripts/snow_game_home_prep_screen.py screen. Season-blocked CI [-24.36, 22.56], P+ 0.4254.
snow_game_home_prep_cover_gap_vs_cold_ou.plain_summary: Comparing snow games only to other freezing outdoor games (not to the whole league), the home team does not show an extra edge from the snow itself -- but there are only 22 snow games to look at.

snow_game_home_prep_cover_gap_vs_populat.classification_evidence: N=22 flagged games (0.5% of the population); interval crosses zero on both week-blocked and season-blocked bootstraps. Per AGENTS.md this is the expected shape for a real small signal at this evaluator's resolution, not a negative; no refuted-mechanism or positive-control ground applies.
snow_game_home_prep_cover_gap_vs_populat.description: LEAD-38: home cover rate in forecast-snow games (outdoor venue, pool_decision-cutoff forecast precip probability >= 50%, forecast temp <= 32F) minus the full REG 2009-2025 population's home cover rate. Predeclared direction: positive (backing home teams in snow games).
snow_game_home_prep_cover_gap_vs_populat.notes: week-blocked primary (block=season*100+week), season-blocked secondary; 20000-draw block bootstrap, seed 20260911; script scripts/snow_game_home_prep_screen.py screen. Season-blocked CI [-20.38, 27.03], P+ 0.5605.
snow_game_home_prep_cover_gap_vs_populat.plain_summary: When the forecast calls for snow at kickoff, home teams cover about 1 point more often than the league average, but snow games are so rare that this could easily be nothing.

snow_game_home_prep_market_pricing_check.classification_evidence: N=22 paired games (season-blocked, 17 season blocks); interval crosses zero. No refuted-mechanism or positive-control ground; the market shows no detectable shading toward home in snow games at this sample size, but this cannot rule out a small one.
snow_game_home_prep_market_pricing_check.description: LEAD-38: diagnostic, not a candidate mechanism. Paired difference between a snow game's home-perspective spread_line and the same home team's other REG home games in the same season that are not snow-flagged. Unsigned/exploratory: tests whether the market already shades the opening-style line toward the home team on forecast-snow games.
snow_game_home_prep_market_pricing_check.notes: diff = snow_game spread_line - mean(control spread_lines), home-perspective sign (negative = market favours home more in the snow game); probability_positive here is defined as P(diff<0), i.e. probability the market already shades toward home, via probability_positive_from_draws(-draws). season-blocked bootstrap, 20000 draws, seed 20260911. script scripts/snow_game_home_prep_screen.py screen.
snow_game_home_prep_market_pricing_check.plain_summary: Checking the betting line itself: sportsbooks do not appear to move the spread specially for snow games compared to that same team's other home games, but the sample is small.
